desc_id: Situs Liyangan di Desa Purbosari, Ngadirejo, ditemukan pada tahun 2008 saat warga menambang pasir. Para peneliti menemukan sisa rumah kayu, bangunan candi, jalan batu, dan butir padi hangus yang tertimbun material letusan Gunung Sindoro.
desc_en: The Liyangan Site in Purbosari Village, Ngadirejo, was found in 2008 while villagers were digging for sand. Researchers found the remains of wooden houses, temple buildings, stone paths and burnt grains of rice, all buried by material from an eruption of Mount Sindoro.
